scope: Audit immutable Project handover-package snapshots against exact readiness, Trial, Tooling, controlled-document and unresolved-action sources without latest-value substitution.
Audit receiving-group and independent acknowledgement semantics while preserving exact actor, time, source revision and unresolved-action ownership and due dates.
Audit a separate post-SOP observation-period snapshot for yield, complaint, cycle and Tooling-stability truth with exact source windows and explicit external unavailability.
Keep G7 evaluation, Work Item or Tooling lifecycle effects and every production transaction behind separately authorized existing policy and execution boundaries.
Define the minimum complete vertical slice, ownership, additive persistence, closed BFF, trilingual industrial workspace, tests, migration and rollback before product code.
non_scope: Product implementation before the P7-06 audit and frozen plan pass.
Automatic G7 pass or close, Gate policy invention, automatic Work Item closure, Tooling lifecycle mutation, production release or production transaction.
Fabricated ERP yield, complaint, cycle, Tooling-stability, quality or production truth; production ERPNext access, customer-system access or mutation.
Treating evidence presence, package creation or acknowledgement as approval, readiness completion, Gate authorization or acceptance by an unavailable external party.
Released Trial Summary, external event projection, production print, raw private File URLs, generic DocType CRUD, core patches, test deletion or threshold reduction.

expected_state.controller_marker: P7-05 Level 2 PASS; P7-06 audit active

rollback.before_product_resume: Restore the P7-05 Level 2 checkpoint; the bounded P7-06 audit creates no product row, route, metadata or external effect.
rollback.after_product_resume: Use the rollback frozen in the accepted P7-06 plan; after retained handover or observation history, disable only independent P7-06 routes and workspace and deliver a reviewed forward repair without rewriting packages, acknowledgements, actions, observations or source snapshots.
